title: Listening Drill — Concert hall acoustics — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Concert hall acoustics — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on concert hall acoustics last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with uneven sound. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: loose panel.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of echo length so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow sound meter instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the audio engineer before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Monday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
